five-number-summary.def: The minimum, first quartile $Q_1$, median, third quartile $Q_3$ and maximum of a data set. Together they split the ordered data into four quarters.

boxplot.def: A graph of the five-number summary: a box from $Q_1$ to $Q_3$ with a line at the median, whiskers to the most extreme values inside the $1.5 \times \text{IQR}$ fences, and outliers drawn as separate points.
